What's your return and refund policy?
Here is a quick overview of how our returns and refunds work:
Returns window and conditions
Full‑price items: Return within 30 days of receipt in their original condition for a refund of the amount you paid.
Sale items: You have 14 days from receipt to register the return with our online returns partner, then a further 14 days to send the item back in its original condition.
Items that cannot be refunded: Swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed, and earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
If your order includes an outstanding pre‑order item, the cost of that outstanding item may be deducted from your refund, with the remaining balance returned to your original payment method.
Returns received after 30 days (or after the sale‑item timelines above) are refunded as account credit for use on a future order.
UK returns
Returns are free within the UK.
International returns
Free returns are not available outside the UK. You can create a return via our partner ZigZag. If your order number begins with GE (placed via Global‑e), please use their returns portal. Please allow up to 14 days for your parcel to reach us.
Refunds, offers and delivery fees
Offers and discounts are applied per item. You will be refunded the price you paid for the returned item after any discount; discounts on items you keep remain in place.
If you paid with a gift voucher and return the order in full, the voucher will be credited again.
Delivery fees are not refunded if an express parcel arrives late.
For full details, including step‑by‑step guidance, please see our Returns and refunds page.
